tools.name: privi_token_market
tools.description:
PRIVI on Base: price, how much PRIVI and USDC the Privi swap desk holds (so whether a swap can fill),
any Uniswap v3 / Aerodrome pools, and optionally a swap quote. Every paid Privi tool also accepts PRIVI. Free.

tools.name: privi_pricing
tools.description: List Privi Verify tools, what each costs, and how payment works.

tools.name: privi_lookup_fingerprint
tools.description: Check whether a record fingerprint (from a label, certificate or document) exists in Privi. Free.

tools.name: privi_verify_lot
tools.description:
Verify a lot: product, first and latest custody events, recall status, and whether
its record history is intact. Paid per call via x402.

tools.name: privi_chain_of_custody
tools.description:
Full ordered event history for a lot with each event's fingerprint, plus an
integrity check of the whole chain. Paid per call via x402.

tools.name: privi_record_event
tools.description:
Append an event to a lot's history (manufacturers only). Requires
'Authorization: Bearer <key>' with a key from PRIVI_WRITE_KEYS. Over stdio,
writes are allowed only when PRIVI_ALLOW_LOCAL_WRITES=1.

tools.name: chainflow_link_lots
tools.description:
Record that one lot was made from another, so a recall can follow the material. Adds an event to both
lots' histories. Manufacturers only.

tools.name: chainflow_recall_trace
tools.description:
Everything a lot touched: the lots made from it (and from those), which have already shipped, which
are not yet recalled, and the lots it was itself made from. The list a recall starts with.

tools.name: chainflow_coc_issue
tools.description:
Issue a Certificate of Conformance for a lot. It names the customer, spec and signer, lists the lot's
attached documents and points at the lot's record, so the buyer can check it has not been edited.
Refused for recalled lots, lots with open non-conformance reports, or altered histories. Manufacture

tools.name: chainflow_coc_verify
tools.description:
Check a Certificate of Conformance a supplier sent you: that it was issued as shown, is not revoked,
and that its lot has not been recalled or altered since.

tools.name: chainflow_coc_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a certificate issued in error. Manufacturers only.

tools.name: chainflow_attach_document
tools.description:
Attach a mill test report, material certificate or inspection report to a lot by fingerprint.
Manufacturers only.

tools.name: chainflow_documents
tools.description: The documents attached to a lot (type, issuer, reference, fingerprint) and common ones still missing.

tools.name: chainflow_document_check
tools.description: Check that a document you were handed is the one attached to a lot, and see which lot.

tools.name: chainflow_ncr_open
tools.description:
Open a non-conformance report (NCR) against a lot. While it is open, no Certificate of Conformance can
be issued for that lot. Manufacturers only.

tools.name: chainflow_ncr_close
tools.description: Close an NCR with its disposition and corrective action. Manufacturers only.

tools.name: chainflow_ncr_list
tools.description: List non-conformance reports with days open, for one lot or all. Manufacturers only.

tools.name: chainflow_gauge_save
tools.description: Add a measuring tool (micrometer, caliper, CMM, torque wrench) to the calibration list. Manufacturers only.

tools.name: chainflow_gauge_calibrated
tools.description: Record a gauge's calibration with the fingerprint of its certificate. Manufacturers only.

tools.name: chainflow_gauges_due
tools.description:
Which gauges are overdue, failed, never calibrated or due within 30 days, and which must not be used.
Manufacturers only.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "privi_record_event" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
